items.caption: A modern redraw of 備 in Western Zhou bronze-script style, based on a form attributed to 元年師⿸㫃史簋. The database interpretation describes a person with an arrow container; compare the form cautiously because the pixels have not been visually inspected in this research stage.
items.alt: Vector redraw identified by its source page as 備 in Western Zhou bronze-script style.
items.selection_reason: A provenance-documented bronze-script candidate relevant to the proposed 人 plus 𤰈 analysis; its precise visible features require the harness’s image inspection.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain, as stated on the Commons file description page.

limitations.text: The candidate is documented as a modern vector redraw, not an artifact photograph. Its pixel appearance was not visually inspected, so no specific visual feature is claimed here.

The historical pronunciation of 𤰈 was not recovered. The modern Mandarin reading fú belongs to 箙, which sources associate with the arrow-container graph; that association does not establish 𤰈’s own reading or prove a historical sound match with 備.
